summary: The student interprets a prompt asking to name the place of a digit as asking for the numeric value of that digit in the number, so they state the place value instead of the positional column name.
subject: MATHEMATICS
teachingImplication: Explicitly distinguish between positional category labels and the numeric quantities represented by digits in those positions.
checkNext: Present an unassisted item asking for the place of a designated digit in a four-digit number with options or prompts requiring column terminology.

evidence.task: Name the place of the second 2 in 2258
